notes.title: Bug Fix 0.3
notes.content: [p]It’s been a while since our last patch. During this time, we've been working hard to fix many of the bugs you've reported and improve the overall stability of the game. [/p][p]Thanks for your patience and continued support![/p][p][/p][p][b]Update Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Issues with the Plater and Grinder machines have been resolved[/p][/*][*][p]Network-related errors have been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaner machine UI has been improved[/p][/*][*][p]HUD has been added for certain objects[/p][/*][*][p]Disconnection issues in multiplayer have been addressed[/p][/*][*][p]Some customer-related bugs have been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Major issues with the cash registers have been largely resolved[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Grinder Machine Fix[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558761/9c11b76c230d00752260b36d27d616680600a179.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Cleaner machine UI upgrade[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558761/1720117453d035390c70131bf36a3f048f686d33.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]HUD has been added for certain objects[/b][/h3][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558761/2c036eb401751d316fb37e4a6691962f3b45f54e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558761/86c0903322c520107f524de9c788275e107c0d45.png"][/img][/carousel][hr][/hr][p][/p]

notes.title: An Honest Dev Note
notes.content: [p][b]We know there's not really a playable game right now.[/b][/p][p]At this stage, we can’t deny that it looks more like an asset pack than an actual game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Our Current Priority List[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]Bugs:[/b] The game is buggy — no question. Fixing every single one of them is our top priority. Right now, we’re not even able to properly show the core mechanics, let alone make it playable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial:[/b] Yes, the tutorial is as old-school as it gets. Unfortunately, due to the bugs, we haven’t been able to focus on it at all. But don’t worry — we’ll write a proper tutorial that works and actually teaches the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sounds:[/b] The game is [i]very[/i] quiet. (In case you didn’t notice — now you know.) I’ve moved sound design up to number 3 on our priority list.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI/UX:[/b] While the UI has gotten some praise, we know the UX side is frustrating. Just like we’re fixing everything else, we’ll improve that too.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][i]Despite all these issues, the interest in our game has been [b]incredible[/b]. The fact that so many of you see potential in it — even in this rough state — is what keeps us going. [b]Thank you for believing in us![/b][/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558761/44b5a23300c110b1c9bca7f5c9a1acab0c4d4e51.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Thank you
notes.content: [p]Thank you very much for your great interest! We've collected all the bug reports and are steadily releasing updates. We appreciate you reporting all the issues in our demo.[/p][p]We are aware of all the unfortunate issues in our demo—don’t worry. We’re constantly fixing them through regular updates.[/p][p]Thank you for your trust and patience.[/p]

notes.title: DEMO IS ACTIVE
notes.content: [h1][b]Welcome to Space Restaurant Demo![/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558761/6f35fdb8c071ab6cb7dd81c0a3e48c0178fc68ba.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Welcome, and thank you for playing![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]As development is still ongoing, current content, performance, and mechanics do not fully represent the final product.[/p][p][/p][p]We are continuously working to improve the game and release regular updates. You can expect frequent enhancements, and we will keep you informed about progress and upcoming changes here, so you and your fellow players can stay up to date.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We truly appreciate your support and interest in our game![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Please note:[/i][/b][i] Multiplayer is currently in its alpha stage.
